meaning:
σύν-ζυγος (Rec. ουζ-), or as WH, mg., Σύνζυγος, -ον
(συνζεύγνυμι), [in Aq., Eze.23:21 * ;]
a yoke fellow. Prob., as proper name, Σ. γνήσιε, genuinely Synzygus, S. properly so-called, Php.4:3 (see ICC, Lft., in l; MM, xxiii).†
(AS)
